channel.title: Business Today India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: February to be hotter, drier this year, says IMD; winter crops may be affected
item.description: Winter-sown crops such as wheat, rapeseed, and chickpeas are typically planted from October to December and require cold conditions for optimal yield.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: ‘When I was in defence, bulletproof jackets were not available for soldiers,’ says FM Sitharaman
item.description: Union Budget 2026: “There are conflicting demands and managing the conflicting demands is the problem,” said FM Sitharaman.

item.title: Budget 2026: Income Tax Act from April 1, higher FPI limits, STT hike headline FM's reform express
item.description: Union Budget 2026 unveiled a sweeping set of tax and financial sector reforms aimed at simplifying compliance, deepening capital markets and improving ease of doing business. Key announcements include the rollout of the new Income Tax Act from April, higher foreign investment limits, STT hikes on derivatives and wide-ranging customs duty relief.

item.title: Goldman Sachs: STT, fears of Monday FPI selling drive worst Budget-day selloff in 6 years
item.description: Gooldman Sachs said the market weakness reflects a combination of concerns around STT on F&O segments, global metal selloff, and domestic selling on low volumes in anticipation of foreign outflows on Monday.

item.title: Stock market: FPIs ‘absent’ on Budget day; analysts flag near-term risk to flows
item.description: Elara Securities said while higher STT on F&O can reduce speculative churn and attract higher long-term investments, the Budget is unlikely to calm the FPI exodus, as FPIs look for signs of earnings recovery.

item.title: 'Border 2' box office collection Day 10: Sunny Deol’s war drama crosses Rs 370 crore worldwide
item.description: Backed by a strong cast featuring Varun Dhawan, Diljit Dosanjh, and Ahan Shetty, the film has managed to stay on course even as Rani Mukerji’s Mardaani 3 fights for audience attention in theatres

item.title: Adani Green, Adani Ports, Adani Power: Adani Group stocks rally up to 5%
item.description: Shares of Adani Group companies were seen rallying higher on Monday with select companies from the Gautam Adani-led conglomerate rising up to 5 per cent.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: Pollution control funding cut even as cities struggle with smog, toxic air
item.description: Budget 2026: In 2024–25, the pollution control budget was initially set at Rs 854 crore, later increased to address shortfalls, but actual expenditure for the year was just Rs 16 crore.

item.title: Union Budget 2026 maintained continuity, attempted structural transformation: SBI Chairman CS Setty
item.description: Budget 2026: “The Union Budget 2026-27 maintains policy continuity, tax predictability while attempting a fine balance between rural & urban, legacy & sunrise sectors,” said CS Setty.

item.title: Budget without ‘big bang’ measures: Nomura sees capex focus as positive, disinvestment target ambitious
item.description: Budget 2026: The foreign brokerage viewed the disinvestment target of Rs 80,000 crore as ambitious, attributing it to optimistic asset monetisation estimates.
